snippet.title: Barfender Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Barfender 🍺

Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar management game where you build your dream bar, serve wild customers, and desperately try to survive the nightly madness. Craft drinks, clean messes, stop bar fights, and keep your crew sanity intact. Do you have what it takes to run the messiest bar in town?

🎮 Demo coming very soon
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159680/Barfender/
Follow Us: https://linktr.ee/BarfenderGame

We’re a small indie team building Barfender with a lot of love, chaos, and spilled drinks. Cheers 🍻
